subject: microbiology
title: Rickettsia, Chlamydia and Mycoplasma

steps.tx: Rickettsiae are obligate intracellular bacilli diagnosed by **Weil-Felix** cross reaction with Proteus OX19, OX2 and OXK strains. Lice spread epidemic typhus with Brill Zinsser recrudescence years later, fleas spread murine typhus, and Dermacentor ticks spread **Rocky Mountain spotted fever**, whose rash marches from **wrists and ankles inward including palms and soles**. **Doxycycline** treats every rickettsial disease, even in children under eight with RMSF where benefit outweighs staining. Fever with rash after tick exposure in forests demands doxy before confirmation, with chloramphenicol second line.
steps.say: Rickettsiae cannot grow outside cells, so serology does the naming. The Weil Felix test cross reacts with Proteus strains, and the pattern points: OXK to scrub typhus, OX19 to typhus group. Lice carry epidemic typhus that can smoulder back years later as Brill Zinsser disease, while ticks carry spotted fever whose rash starts at wrists and ankles and marches inward across palms and soles. Doxycycline is the treatment for every member of the group, even in young children with spotted fever, and it must be started on suspicion before reports return. Chloramphenicol is the second line alternative.

steps.tx: **Scrub typhus** from Orientia carried by chigger mites announces itself with an **eschar**, a cigarette burn ulcer with regional nodes after forest exposure in the tsutsugamushi triangle. Fever follows with hepatitis like transaminases, pneumonitis and meningoencephalitis. **Q fever** from Coxiella needs no vector, riding parturition products and dust with virulent phase I organisms to cause atypical pneumonia, granulomatous hepatitis and culture negative endocarditis. **Doxycycline** cures both, while Q endocarditis needs doxy with hydroxychloroquine for 18 months as phase I titres are followed.
steps.say: Scrub typhus is the fever to suspect after scrub vegetation exposure. A chigger bite leaves a black cigarette burn ulcer with swollen regional nodes, which is the eschar to search for, and fever follows with liver, lung and brain involvement. Q fever arrives without any vector through dust from animal births, and it causes atypical pneumonia with granulomatous hepatitis and endocarditis that never grows in culture. Doxycycline cures both presentations, while Q fever endocarditis additionally needs prolonged hydroxychloroquine with phase one titres followed for eighteen months.

steps.tx: The foot carries the unmissable **eschar** of **scrub typhus**, a black cigarette burn crater with a red rim where the chigger fed. The inset shows the tender **regional nodes** draining it in the groin, the adenopathy examiners expect you to feel for. Forest or scrub exposure with fever after such a lesion means doxycycline at once, since serology lags behind disease. Untreated cases seed hepatitis, pneumonitis and encephalitis, which is why the eschar must never be missed on rounds.
steps.say: Look at the black crater first. The foot shows a cigarette burn eschar with a red rim, which is the bite mark of scrub typhus, and the inset shows the swollen groin nodes that drain it. This combination after forest or scrub exposure with fever is diagnostic enough to start doxycycline at once, which is the rule because serology returns late. Untreated disease spreads to liver, lung and brain, so the eschar is the finding that must be hunted on every round.

steps.tx: Chlamydia lives obligatorily inside cells, shifting between infectious **elementary body** forms outside and replicating reticulate bodies inside. Trachomatis A to C causes trachoma, fought with the SAFE strategy of surgery, antibiotics, face washing and environment. D to K causes inclusion conjunctivitis, NGU, cervicitis and PID, while L1 to L3 causes **LGV** with groove sign nodes across inguinal and femoral chains plus rectal strictures. Psittaci from birds and pneumoniae as TWAR both cause atypical pneumonia. **NAAT** diagnoses genital disease, and single dose **azithromycin** or doxycycline treats with partner therapy.
steps.say: Chlamydia alternates between two forms, and the distinction is examined. The elementary body survives outside cells and starts infection, while the reticulate body replicates inside, which is why antibiotics must enter cells. Serovars A to C scar the eyelid in trachoma, which is managed by the SAFE strategy, D to K infect the genital tract, and L1 to L3 invade lymphatics as LGV with the groove sign. Bird contact points to psittaci pneumonia, NAAT is the diagnostic test for genital disease, and single dose azithromycin with partner therapy is the treatment that clears it.

steps.tx: Mycoplasma pneumoniae has no cell wall, ignores Gram stain and resists beta lactams, growing into **fried egg colonies** needing sterols as the Eaton agent. It causes **walking pneumonia** in schoolchildren with dry cough and patchy infiltrates, plus bullous myringitis, **cold agglutinins** with haemolysis, Stevens Johnson syndrome and transverse myelitis. Treatment is **macrolides** or doxycycline. M. genitalium causes NGU answered by azithromycin with moxifloxacin backup as resistance spreads, Ureaplasma splits urea in neonatal disease, NAAT diagnoses both since culture is too slow, and wall less L forms persist after beta lactams.
steps.say: Mycoplasma breaks the bacterial rules. It builds no wall, so Gram stain shows nothing and beta lactams cannot touch it, which is the central logic. Slow culture grows fried egg colonies that demand sterols, and schoolchildren develop walking pneumonia with dry cough and patchy shadows. Ear bullae, cold agglutinins, skin and cord complications mark severe cases, which are treated with macrolides or doxycycline. Genitalium causes urethritis that answers to azithromycin, Ureaplasma troubles newborns, and NAAT is the test because culture is too slow.
